_doc: Milford Road Course through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; Kevin 2026-10-28: 'rebuild all four with the Lake Murray chain'). The draft is the engine's own on the NAIP-traced line (source.type from_track: gps -> elev -> project -> mesh), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter / spawn builder run from airoso's scripts/ac (never engine-july: San Diego's alone), the four gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso (the sync rails require it).
_owed: First pass = the draft through the chain, no authoring yet: no signs (signs.json), no lamps, no race layouts, no TreeFX (make_treefx reads SD-shaped zones; V3-PLAN P1 'other adapted tools'). The real 4-8 % corner banking is lidar fact the draft builds flat (DOSSIER Part D §3): an authoring item, never curvature-invented (L10).
